checks.operator_rails_and_abutments: All orientations have distinct material-coloured rail/parapet bands on both long sides, nominally 2-3px with dark 1px outlines, locally enlarged at posts/braces. checks.operator_material_identity: Timber post-and-rail fantasy; arched stone/red lacquer/light crown wuxia; visibly braced steel jazz_age; concrete/metal guard rail modern; dark metal/cyan edges scifi; patched scrap/plank wasteland. All identities survive at 1x and across orientations.
checks.operator_winter: All 24 winters retain the family material and a readable road centre, with small attached rail caps and deck-side snow edges. No blank winter or random white deck pixels were found. Four previously failed cases now pass; see resolved_previous_failures.
checks.size_placement_width: Every file is RGBA 48x48. h/v are centred edge-to-edge; d1/d2 use the required opposite corners. Actual road reference atlas straight widths are about 20-22px, wider than the approximate 12-14px prose estimate; preserve the real road joins, as in the previous accepted review. The four local winter repairs do not move deck entrances or change their widths.
checks.approved_art_comparison: Viewed approved-markers-1x (all six families), approved-round2-paddies-1x (representative city, slums, industry, suburb, farmland, paddies and farmsteads), approved-grass/plains-1x (all seasons with base/detail examples), road-versus-bridge-4x and approved-context-summer/winter-4x. checks.duplicates: No exact RGBA duplicates among the 48. Family materials remain distinct. Orientation-related similarity and summer/winter shared construction are required continuity rather than rejected duplicate variants.
checks.bases_3x3: Not applicable: no candidate bases in Part B. Supplemental approved summer/winter grass and plains 3x3 sheets are saved as context only; these receive no new verdict.
